mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.2 percentage point rise in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the trigger condition remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contracting housing market that precedes broader consumer demand weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply-side constraints that reduce corporate profitability expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent price pressures that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC for the trigger condition remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and declines in FEDFUNDS signal inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as market confidence erodes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand phases, a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) indicates potential overhang in housing market activity that signals reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of strong consumer demand periods when RSAFS declines, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.04.
